title: fix: Refactor GetModifiedSettingsContent for PS5 compatibility
summary: The GetModifiedSettingsContent function now explicitly lists property names instead of using wildcards in Select-Object to ensure compatibility with PowerShell 5.
key_points: Fixed property handling in GetModifiedSettingsContent function
Explicitly lists properties instead of wildcard expansion
Prevents literal '*' property from being added in PowerShell 5
Includes unit tests for the change
